nodes.title: How to compare
widgets_values:
## QuokkaiLab - Audio Conditioning Fix

Input: clean mono speech. ON: 70 Hz amplitude modulation, 180-6500 Hz band-pass and peak normalization to 0.95, preserving timing and silence boundaries. OFF: clean audio conditioning (baseline).

LTX receives the selected conditioning audio; the MP4 ALWAYS receives clean speech with the same trim/padding. Both passes freeze the encoded audio.

Observed in production: improved English speech/lip-sync on selected clips. The underlying cause is unproven; results depend on the input.

Use the same start.png, speech.wav, prompt, seeds and settings in both files. See README.md for setup and the demo protocol.
Keep both samplers and seeds identical for the comparison.

widgets_values_named.text: Do explore various samplers and cfg values (although we advise them to be kept close to 1)
